note.after_visit_summary: You have atrial fibrillation, which is under control. Your blood pressure is at goal. You are taking apixaban to prevent stroke, metoprolol to control your heart rate, and lisinopril for blood pressure. Stop taking aspirin because it increases your risk of bleeding while on apixaban and does not help your heart. Continue taking fish oil. Use a soft toothbrush and tell your dentist about your gum bleeding. Get a blood count check in 3 months at the lab on 2210 Wexford Avenue. Call if you have black stools, blood in urine, or a nosebleed that does not stop after 20 minutes. If you fall and hit your head, go to the emergency room right away, even if you feel fine. Return in 6 months for follow-up.
